title: Global asymptotic stability of the infection equilibrium of a delayed HIV model with CTL immune response and immune impairment (Theorem 3.4)
author: Guangsheng Lai; Zhiting Xu
work: Analysis of an HIV infection model with delays
source_version: Electronic Journal of Differential Equations 2026, No. 20, pp. 1--14; DOI 10.58997/ejde.2026.20; publisher version
difficulty_reason: The counted theorem is the paper's strongest dynamical conclusion: the global asymptotic stability of the infection equilibrium of a four-dimensional delayed HIV model that carries a logistic proliferation of target cells, a saturating incidence, an immune-impairment term in the CTL equation and three independent delays. After the well-posedness, the next infection operator, the equilibria and the characteristic-equation results are supplied as context, the proof still has to build a source-local object: the two-part Lyapunov functional N = N_1 + N_2, whose first part is a sum of the fundamental function at the four equilibrium coordinates and whose second part consists of two delay integrals with the correctly weighted integrands (lines 681--695); it then has to differentiate that functional along the flow, insert the four equilibrium identities to replace the production, infection and clearance parameters (lines 733--742), and reduce the resulting expression, by repeated regrouping and by the logarithmic bookkeeping of the fundamental function, to a sum of negative definite squares and of terms of the shape u - 1 - ln u, which is where the strict positivity of the logistic coefficient under the condition $x_{\rm max}(r-d) < r x^{*}$ is used (lines 744--827); and it must then identify the largest invariant subset of the zero set of the derivative and invoke LaSalle invariance to conclude (lines 828--834). The method is classical but its execution is entirely paper-specific: the weights of the delay integrals and the cancellation pattern have to be found, and the reduction is a long non-obvious algebraic chain that no qualifying examination would ask for, so the unit is graded H2 rather than H3 because every ingredient is a named classical device rather than a new research mechanism.
